entries.en: We don't have anything yet.
But Fist has her!
I still don't trust you.
The one I told you about, Shepard.
Just like Wrex told us, Commander.
Yeah, we heard about him.
Let her go.
Hey, I know you. You're Shepard, right?
It's an honor to meet you, Commander. What are you doing down here in the wards? Anything I can help you with?
Hey, Commander Shepard. Good to see you again. Anything you need?
Right. You're probably real busy. Well, see you around, Commander.
I saw the monument at Akuze. They've got a whole section about you there. It's a miracle you survived.
I was on Mindoir during the Blitz. Saw you on the vids when you got your medal. You saved the whole colony!
Torfan was a case study during my training. I can't believe you took out the whole base. Amazing!
Looks like you have a fan.
I'm sorry. I've just never thought I'd meet someone like you in person. My name's Lang. Officer Eddie Lang, Citadel Securtiy.
I don't know. Seemed like the right thing to do, you know? Maybe it's in my blood. My grandfather was a cop back on Earth.
It's kind of what C-Sec is. Police for the Citadel. I'm still pretty new at it, but I like it so far. Way more interesting than staying back on Earth.
You get to meet all kinds of cool aliens. Like those hanar. Wild. Plus, C-Sec gets a lot of respect here. We uphold the law. People--even aliens--appreciate that.
This place is amazing! I've been here almost a year and I still haven't seen a tenth of it. The Presidium's just so beautiful. Good place to go and relax.
But I really like it here down in the wards. There's always something going on somewhere.
Like that new club they just opened a few months ago, Flux. Wicked scene in there, Commander. You should check it out when you have some time.
I shouldn't really say too much. He's been on the force a lot longer than me. But I've heard things, you know?
Drinking on the job, taking bribes, that kind of thing. Rumors, mostly. But they suspended him, so some of it must be true.
Why'd you join Citadel Security?
How do you like working here on the Citadel?
Do you know a C-Sec officer named Harkin?
What do you know about Spectres?
Just the stuff they show in the vids. They always make them out to be super agents on secret missions to save the galaxy. I know it's not really like that, though.
Some of the other C-Sec guys don't like them too much. Figure they shouldn't be able to operate outside the law.
But if they were so bad, the Council wouldn't use them, right?
That's not what I heard.
And what did you hear, exactly?
More rumors about strange metal creatures with real AI, no doubt.
Yes, but there's more.
There always is.
I heard they had some connection with a rogue Spectre.
Not this again.
Why is that so hard to believe?
Whatever you say. Just don't expect us to believe it, too.
What? Everyone knows Fist is in with the local criminals.
Maybe, but I wouldn't go shouting it from the mountaintops.
Unless you want to end up on his hit list.
Yeah, I heard he actually buried some corpses under the stage at Chora's Den.
Wouldn't put it past him.
Yeah, and it might explain the stench in that place.
I still can't believe that could happen out in the open like that.
Neither could he. The C-Sec agent said there's been an increase in violent crimes in this area lately.
Did he say why?
No, he kinda skirted the issue.
It's those damn humans, if you ask me.
They're not all bad. They're just different, mostly.
I don't like 'em. They all act like they've been living here forever. The Citadel is ours.
You should be careful who you say that around.
I'm waiting for someone else.
Place is busier than usual.
Hey.
Try your luck at Quasar yet?
Hey, good to see another human in here.
Not a bad place, but it's just not the same as back home.
Drinks aren't bad, but good luck finding a beer here.
Having fun?
Drinks and dancing down below, gambling up above... good place to blow off some steam.
Aw, man! My sisters would love this place. Maybe when this is all over, I'll bring them here for a girls' night out.
If we weren't on duty, I'd have to show you some of my dance moves... sir.
Why is the music in these places always so loud? It almost seems as if the people here want an excuse not to talk to each other.
You almost never see any keepers in this club. I guess they don't care what happens here. That, or the music keeps them away.
Hmph. Places like this always want to hire krogan bouncers. It's like we're a status symbol for them.
This music is... interesting. I wonder if I can find a copy to bring back to the flotilla?
Welcome to Flux. Name's Doran. What can I do for you?
Owner, cook, and bartender. I've even been known to dance a little when the mood strikes me.
Enjoy your time here at Flux.
Among other things, yes.
Let me see that. You got that from Schells, didn't you?
I saw him using it earlier. Tossed him out on his ass for it, too. Thanks for bringing this to me.
I agree with you on that. Thanks again. Take a few shots at the quasar, on the house.
I suppose it is. Take a few tries of quasar, on the house.
Hello again. Can I help you?
Well, Jenna left to work at Chora's Den. Now her sister Rita is all worried she might be in some kind of trouble.
Not much chance Jenna will change her mind, though. She's a stubborn one.
Are you the owner?
Is this a casino?
I've got something you might be interested in.
Cheaters shouldn't prosper.
I think that tool should be worth something to you.
What can you tell me about the sisters working for you?
You own this place?
[Give him Schells' tool.]
Rita and Jenna
We've got some quasar stations if you're interested.
If she wanted to come back, I'd take her in a second. The customers loved her.
I'm watching you. No more tricks or you'll be out on your ass too.
Sorry, I'm kinda busy right now. So, uh, what can I do for you?
Who, Doran? I was just asking him about my sister. She worked for Doran before she left to...
Sorry, I don't want to bore you with my problems.
Well, okay. My sister Jenna left here to go work at Chora's Den.
The problem is, she's working as an informant for C-Sec. You know, eavesdropping on the people there.
If they find out what she's doing, they'll kill her.
That's what I've been telling her.
This "stupid mistake" might cost her her life!
They can't watch her all the time.
I don't know. Sometimes I think she stays there just to spite me.
Oh. Thanks.
Is there something you want?
Oh, hey. Thanks for the talk earlier. I hope I didn't bore you with my stories about my sister.
Hey, any luck with Jenna?
Hey there. Any luck?
I'm good, thanks.
What were you discussing with the volus?
I'm interested to hear what you have to say.
Being an informant is a dangerous job.
You can't stop her from making stupid mistakes.
I assume C-Sec is protecting her?
Maybe I could help her understand just how dangerous Chora's Den is.
I won't pry. Good luck.
It's okay. Go on.
That's not good.
Is she really at risk?
I'll speak with her.
Would you? That'd be great. Just don't tell her I sent you.
Well, I should get back to work before I get in trouble. Thanks.
No, it's all very secret.
Oh, no rush. I appreciate you doing this.
Oh yeah, sure. She's over in Chora's Den waiting tables.
That's great. I'm sorry about Jenna; she's always been like that. She won't learn until it's too late.
I hope it works out. Goodbye.
Do you know who her contact at C-Sec is?
I haven't spoken with her.
Can you tell me again where to find her?
She wouldn't discuss it with me. But I think I might have a lead.
That's okay.
Not really.
Gotta go.
Have you talked to C-Sec?
Hey, Jenna came back looking for work. Thanks for getting her out of Chora's Den.
Yeah, everyone seems real happy to have her back.
You don't sound too happy.
I'm glad she's out of the Den. I'd just forgotten what it was like to have her around.
I haven't had a decent tip since she got back.
Rita, I've got an order for you.
Oh, I gotta go. Thanks again for looking into this.
I was glad to help out.
I talked to her contact. We might be able to work something out.
That's good to hear.
Spoke with C-Sec.
Commander. Thank you again for all your help.
Hey, Commander. Good to see you again.
How's it going, Commander?
I sense that you are less than pleased with her return.
You don't sound that happy about it.
